		"type": "git",

name: Prepare CLI release
run-name: Release operation ${{ inputs.beepboop_execution_id }}
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      beepboop_execution_id:
        description: Beepboop preparation execution
        required: true
        type: string
permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write }
concurrency:
  group: cli-prepare-${{ inputs.beepboop_execution_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - uses: $/actions/begin
        id: release
        with:
          execution-id: ${{ inputs.beepboop_execution_id }}
          stream: cli
          operation: prepare
      - name: Checkout planned source
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ fromJSON(steps.release.outputs.context).sourceSha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/actions/prepare
        with:
          mode: apply
          context: ${{ steps.release.outputs.context }}
      - run: bun install
      - run: bun run check
      - run: bun test
      - run: bun run build:cli
      - run: bun run check:cli
      - run: bun run check:jsr
      - uses: $/actions/prepare
        with:
          mode: submit
          context: ${{ steps.release.outputs.context }}

name: Publish CLI
run-name: Release operation ${{ inputs.beepboop_execution_id }}
on:
  release:
    types: created
#  workflow_dispatch:
#    inputs:
#      beepboop_execution_id:
#        description: Approved Beepboop promotion execution
#        required: true
#        type: string
permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write }
concurrency:
  group: cli-publication
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with: { node-version-file: "mise.toml", package-manager-cache: false }
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - uses: $/actions/begin
        id: release
        with:
          execution-id: ${{ inputs.beepboop_execution_id }}
          stream: cli
          operation: promote
      - name: Checkout approved source
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ fromJSON(steps.release.outputs.context).sourceSha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run check
      - run: bun test
      - run: bun run build:cli
      - run: bun run check:cli
      - run: bun run check:jsr
      - name: Validate release version
        id: metadata
        run: bun src/tooling/cli/release.ts metadata
        env:
          RELEASE_CONTEXT: ${{ steps.release.outputs.context }}
      - name: Publish npm
        id: npm
        run: bun src/tooling/cli/release.ts npm
        env:
          RELEASE_CONTEXT: ${{ steps.release.outputs.context }}
      - name: Publish JSR
        id: jsr
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.metadata.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: bunx jsr publish --config packages/cli/jsr.json
      - name: Publication report
        id: report
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.metadata.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: bun src/tooling/cli/release.ts report
        env:
          RELEASE_CONTEXT: ${{ steps.release.outputs.context }}
          NPM_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.npm.outcome }}
          JSR_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.jsr.outcome }}
      - uses: $/actions/report
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.report.outcome == 'success' }}
        with:
          execution-id: ${{ steps.release.outputs.execution-id }}
          publications: ${{ steps.report.outputs.publications }}

name: Publish Actions
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: { contents: read }
concurrency:
  group: publish-actions
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  verify:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    uses: $/.github/workflows/ci.yml
  publish:
    needs: verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions: { contents: write }
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with: { node-version-file: "mise.toml" }
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun test test/winget.test.ts ./test/actions/winget.ts
      - name: Publish distribution commit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          repository_url="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"
          head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          [[ "${head}" == "${GITHUB_SHA}" ]]
          git diff --exit-code HEAD
          index_dir=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "${index_dir}"' EXIT
          export GIT_INDEX_FILE="${index_dir}/index"
          git read-tree "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          tree=$(git write-tree)
          parents=(-p "${GITHUB_SHA}")
          previous=$(git ls-remote --exit-code origin refs/heads/actions) || {
            result=$?
            if [[ "${result}" -ne 2 ]]; then exit "${result}"; fi
          }
          if [[ -n "${previous}" ]]; then
            read -r previous _ <<< "${previous}"
            git fetch --no-tags origin "${previous}"
            previous_source=$(git rev-parse "${previous}^1")
            git merge-base --is-ancestor "${previous_source}" "${GITHUB_SHA}"
            parents+=(-p "${previous}")
            previous_tree=$(git rev-parse "${previous}^{tree}")
            if [[ "${previous_source}" == "${GITHUB_SHA}" && "${previous_tree}" == "${tree}" ]]; then
              echo "Actions already published at [\`${previous}\`](${repository_url}/commit/${previous})." >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          commit=$(git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit-tree "${tree}" "${parents[@]}" -m "Publish Actions from ${GITHUB_SHA}")
          git push origin "${commit}:refs/heads/actions"
          {
            echo "Source commit: [\`${GITHUB_SHA}\`](${repository_url}/commit/${GITHUB_SHA})"
            echo "Published Actions commit: [\`${commit}\`](${repository_url}/commit/${commit})"
            echo
            echo "Pin consumers to \`kjanat/beepboop/actions/generate-winget@${commit}\`."
          } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
